ian: FYI we just got a support ticket from cust-451 — they're seeing a spike in parse failures when using json_mode=true. Error shows `invalid json` and `parse_failure` tag in logs. Anyone can pick this up?

ryan: can you paste a request_id + model + example output? I want to pull traces.

ian: request_id=abc123, endpoint `/v1/generate`, model=open-redwood-v2, json_mode=true. Customer attached the output sample — looks like trailing comma + weird char: 
```json
{\"items\": [{\"id\": \"1\", \"text\": \"hello\",}, {\"id\":\"2\",\"text\":\"hi\"}]}
```

mira: grabbing logs. If we don't have trace id we can search by request_id. I'm seeing a 5xx from runtime at 2026-03-15T18:12:34Z with tag `parse_error`. Query I'm using in logs: 
```
service:runtime AND json_mode:true AND tag:parse_error
```
I'll add a temporary log facet `json_parse_failure` to make counts easier.

alex: we should NOT dump raw model outputs into logs. Add redaction before writing samples. Also we need a metric: `jsonmode.parse_failures` with labels {route, model, redaction_status}. That will make dashboards + alerts possible.

ryan: repro steps from support: 
1) POST /v1/generate with schema Y and prompt X
2) set temperature=0.9
3) call 5x -> 2/5 produce trailing comma invalid JSON
I can repro locally with the same seed. I'll attach a minimal repro.

mira: proposed action items:
- create Grafana panel: jsonmode.parse_failures by model/route (I'll PR)
- add log scrubber to runtime pipeline to mask outputs before storing (ryan)
- surface redacted sample failures in Console under Support -> Samples (alex)
- add alert: jsonmode.parse_fail_rate > 1% over 10m for any route (oncall)

oncall-bot: Alert created: `JSONModeParseFailure > 1% (10m)` — escalated to #eng-oncall

sara: ack. I'll author the runbook entry and attach playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/jsonmode-parse

ryan: uploading repro gist and linking a trace: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/abc123

ian: customer notified that we're investigating. Will update when we have mitigations. Thanks team :thumbsup:

mira: one more note — include `redaction_status` label with values masked|raw in telemetry so SRE can filter out potentially sensitive samples. I'll add that to telemetry schema change.

alex: also think about a sampled-capture: capture only 1/100 failing outputs to minimize exposure while still enabling debugging. Could be config on the runtime.

ian: leaving this open until dashboards + alert + scrubber are in. Last update ~1h ago.
